# VirtualTabs

> Canonical documentation index for VirtualTabs, a VS Code extension for
> persistent virtual file groups, multi-root workspaces, and AI-agent
> integration.

This file is an index, not a copy of the source documentation. Follow the
linked canonical document for current rules, commands, counts, and procedures.

## Canonical Documentation

- [Product overview and usage](https://github.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/blob/main/README.md)
- [Development and extension architecture](https://github.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/blob/main/DEVELOPMENT.md)
- [Testing](https://github.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/blob/main/docs/TESTING.md)
- [Contributing](https://github.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Release policy](https://github.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/blob/main/docs/RELEASE_POLICY.md)
- [MCP client setup](https://github.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/blob/main/docs/mcp-setup.md)
- [MCP server reference](https://github.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/blob/main/mcp-server/README.md)
- [Agent Skill behavior and safety](https://github.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/blob/main/skills/virtualtabs/SKILL.md)
- [Localization and translation policy](https://github.com/winterdrive/vscode-virtual-tabs/blob/main/I18N.md)
